title: THE FANTASY COLLECTION ファンタジー作品集 version3.0
description:
Apologies for the numerous remakes. Everything should be sorted out now. Ultimately I had to remove one file because I couldn't get my software to work with it no matter what I did. 

As with my other torrents, you can select EN and JP folders in your client for English and Japanese materials respectively. You can also select other folders for content that doesn’t fit well into either of those, such as NO TEXT. Since this adds upon a previous version you’ll need to select that way in both the OLD and NEW folders. IF YOU ALREADY DOWNLOADED THE PREVIOUS TORRENTS, YOU ONLY NEED NEW.

This collection is for fantastic elements in anime/manga. Many stories here parody sci-fi or fantasy stories. Others have monster girls, super powers (e.g. time-stopping), mad scientists, body swaps, and aliens (not so much of the tentacles though; I don’t care for them).

You’ll also need THE INCEST COLLECTION 近親相姦作品集 if you want all my best fantasy titles. I wanted to split by theme as best I could, so most fantasy items that include incest wind up in the incest collection instead of this one. For example, nekomata, bakegitsune, and other jingaikko appear in [猫玄] 都合のいい少女/Convenient Girl, and みんなの先生 and there’s a nice multi-chapter elf harem in [おるとろ] とろかせおるがずむ [DL版], even though I put these books in the incest collection instead.

FUTANARI WARNING: If you don’t know what a futanari is, you should probably deselect the FUTA folder in your client. Futa and fantasy overlap so much in H-manga I didn’t see any reason to make a separate torrent. That said, my stuff is pretty tame by futa standards. I delete a giant pile of unpleasant titles for every one I keep. Also note that futa does not go in The Incest Collection, so all my futa incest stories go in this set. SIDE NOTE: The futa folder contains a Pretty Face doujin, WHICH IS NOT FUTA, but I didn’t want to upset anyone unprepared for it because they never read Pretty Face. If you have never read Pretty Face, do it now. It’s one of the better comics I’ve seen over the years.

NYOTAIKA WARNING: I separated titles with “female body change” into a different folder. Hopefully this helps anyone who wants to avoid that stuff (not that I believe anyone reads my tl;dr descriptions).

FURTHER WARNING: Other content in this set may put off leechers who want only “vanilla” sex. (I don’t know why you would look at this anyway…) To name a few: saimin/brainwash/mind control powers, yuri, loli, and (straight) shota. I also made an extreme content folder you can deselect to avoid items I judged more likely to upset readers. In many ways these titles are like others in the collection. There isn’t a clear border for what does or doesn’t go in “extreme content.” For most, I simply thought some element would bother people more than the rest (like how Natsu is an actual bear (albeit a talking one), as distinct from a therianthropic deity or “furry” of some kind, in a certain Kuma Miko doujin). Offending content may only last a page or two (e.g. a brief scene of extreme gore), with [左藤空気] 愛聖天使ラブメアリー ～悪性受胎～ being the most notable exception to this, as part of it depicts the corruption of a male “magical girl” (the only gay shota in this collection) resulting in nyotaika, and weird monsters appear throughout the book. There are probably more tentacles in 愛聖天使ラブメアリー than in all the rest of the collection combined (though the number of BLACK DOG titles I’ll keep adding over time will undoubtedly change that).

Description:

Nikaidou Tasuku, the protagonist, has looked up to his mother, Chihiro, since he was a boy. But before he knew it, his feelings were no longer merely platonic.

Unable to confess his feelings, he believes it will be enough for things to stay as they were, as long as it means he gets to stay by her side.

However, a sudden incident causes him to undergo a change of heart, and he decides it is better to have loved and lost than never loved at all.

From then on he does his utmost to make his mother fall for him...
